t: You're outside St Thomas' Hospital, a large NHS teaching hospital in Lambeth. It's part of the Guy's and St Thomas' trust and one of three sites used by King's College London's medical school. Several well-known people died here. The poet Dame Edith Sitwell did, and so did the harmonica player Larry Adler. The actor Murray Melvin died here too. So did Mary Wilson, the poet and wife of Prime Minister Harold Wilson, who lived to 102. The community leader and activist Olive Morris also died here, in 1979. Jack Brooksbank, who is married to Princess Eugenie, was born here.
